case: PostgreSQL numeric[] XLSX re-import through LibreOffice Calc
contract: The PostgreSQL numeric[] contains a 40-digit integer, high-scale decimal, scale-preserving 1.2300, NaN, positive/negative Infinity and SQL NULL. Native array_to_json and array_send oracles confirm the exact array values and bytes after binding and SQL replay.
BookieE writes the numeric[] representation into an XLSX shared-string cell without a formula.
LibreOffice Calc opens the workbook and saves ODS, then reopens and saves XLSX; the exact 122-character cell remains unchanged across all three artifacts.

bookiee_export.command: rtk proxy env BOOKIEE_XLSX_REIMPORT_ARTIFACT=/home/trung/Projects/tablepro/linux/docs/evidence/postgres-numeric-array-calc-reimport-results-2026-10-04/source.xlsx cargo test --locked --package tablepro-driver-postgres --test integration array_contract::value_contract_numeric_array_file_exports_preserve_exact_text -- --include-ignored --exact --test-threads=1

steps: In the pinned Debian image, apt installs libreoffice-calc; Calc opens source.xlsx and saves calc-roundtrip.ods.
Calc reopens calc-roundtrip.ods and saves calc-roundtrip.xlsx.

consumer_assertions.method: Python standard-library ZIP/XML checks require a shared-string cell in both XLSX files, a string cell in ODS, exact array text equality, and no formulas.
consumer_assertions.result: All three artifacts contain the same exact text cell; no formulas.

clippy.command: rtk proxy cargo clippy --locked --package tablepro-driver-postgres --all-targets -- -D warnings

remaining: Calc re-import for other PostgreSQL array families and other spreadsheet applications remains open in B3.
